claims.originating_goal: Restore the existing CFP/NCAAF Site surface as a current-season, freshness-aware tracker without allowing historical 2025 CFP data to masquerade as current 2026 data.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release only after the CFP restoration is merged or explicitly superseded, repository preflight and CFP-specific validation pass, required README changes are included, and deployed/public behavior is observed without stale historical data being presented as current.
expected_evidence: Site Handoff Orchestrator PASS for goal/cfp-live-2026-revival
Ecosystem Heartbeat Orchestration admission compatible with the claimed workload
season-aware CFP/NCAAF data contract and freshness validator
one canonical ingestion path and scheduled/manual workflow
current-season games and clearly labeled non-CFP polls when available
official CFP rankings represented as not yet released until authoritative publication
historical bracket/team pages explicitly labeled historical rather than current
README.md, cfp/README_CFP.md, and data/README-cfp-source.md updated with changed freshness/ingestion semantics
browser/static validation and deployed public observation
collision_boundaries: Do not modify HIL live-execution, coherent-transition-threshold, heartbeat, SV001 custody, InTr, TV/TVC, LLM-adapter, Master Records, or resident-runtime ownership surfaces.
Do not create a second sports scheduler or parallel live CFP data contract; consolidate existing CFP ingestion implementations into one canonical path.
Do not infer current CFP committee rankings from AP, Coaches, historical CFP, source timestamps, or deployment timestamps.
Historical cfp-2025 consumers may remain only when explicitly labeled historical and must not claim current CFP status.
Do not introduce provider credentials, GitHub-token runtime authority, wagering authority, ticketing authority, or publication authority.
Do not claim activation or live behavior from source, CI, merge, or deployment alone.
claims.next_task_after_release: Verify public CFP behavior and, only if the sports lane becomes a governed publication source, evaluate existing Publisher/admissibility/StegGuardian propagation contracts without creating duplicate downstream lanes.
